science.qualification: Infrared false color of the whole disc from published flux densities (Marois et al. (2007); Stolker et al. (2021); McElwain et al. (2007), as compiled in Best, Liu, Magnier & Dupuy (2024), The UltracoolSheet v2.1 (Zenodo); zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service, UltracoolSheet Main.csv, GQ Lup b: MKO K 13.37 +/- 0.12 (Maro07), MKO H 14.02 +/- 0.13 (Stol21), 2MASS J 14.9 +/- 0.11 (McEl07); SVO MKO/NSFCam.K 638.2 Jy, MKO/NSFCam.H 1034.8 Jy, 2MASS/2MASS.J 1594.0 Jy): red MKO K 2.184 µm, green MKO H 1.614 µm, blue 2MASS J 1.235 µm, on one range shared with the bodies the record names. The planet is unresolved, so no map is implied. It glows with its own heat, so no lighting.
